messages:
Evan Lee: Dropping a quick design check for the playground action bar. Prototype shows Stop (label + icon), a compact Cost badge, and a kebab for secondary actions including Regenerate and Insert to prompt library. Link: https://redwood.internal/s/ghi789
Nora Patel: Clean. Mobile concern: cost badge might wrap and push actions down. Suggest transform to an icon-only badge on narrow widths that opens a full cost panel on tap.
Ben Walker: Agree. Also propose debounce visual updates for cost during streaming (250ms) and backend can send summarized snapshots. Avoid flicker.
Iris Tan: Accessibility: make Stop button accessible name "Stop generation". Cost panel must have role=dialog and focus trap. Also color contrast for the orange cost badge is failing on dark mode.
Evan Lee: Plan: 1) cost badge collapses on small screens; 2) cost panel shows input/output/total tokens + estimated cost + last-updated; 3) debounce frontend updates to 250ms; 4) move Regenerate into kebab menu and show soft-confirm when estimated cost > $0.75.
ux-bot: Design token note: updated color scale and added high-contrast token for badges (figma: playground/bars/v3).
Nora Patel: Microcopy: change menu label to "Regenerate response" and toast text to "Regeneration may incur additional cost". Users found terse copy confusing in tests.
Ben Walker: Shortcut idea: ESC to stop, Shift+Enter to regenerate. Confirm Shift+Enter doesn't conflict with compose flow.
Iris Tan: I'll run a quick screen-reader pass once comps are pushed. Evan, please tag when ready.
Evan Lee: Will do  updating comps now and adding an accessibility checklist. Thanks all. :sparkles:
